tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Returns the company name, operator, contact email, homepage, and a short description of gethal.ai.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Returns pricing for all four HAL products (Outreach, inbox-agent, Saga, vitr) plus the Outreach plans (Team, Enterprise) with monthly and yearly rates and included features.

tools.name: get_products
tools.description: Returns the four HAL products (Outreach, inbox-agent, Saga, vitr): what each does, how it works on its own and together with the others, its page URL and pricing model.

tools.name: get_features
tools.description: Returns the six core features of gethal.ai with one-line descriptions.

tools.name: get_use_cases
tools.description: Returns representative B2B sales use cases (outbound prospecting, market expansion, partner-channel sales) with example prompts.

tools.name: get_playbook
tools.description: Returns the HAL playbook: guides and cheat sheets on working with each product (for Outreach: what HAL does in each pipeline stage, and the requests customers send HAL most), with page URLs and PDF downloads in English and Danish. Optionally filter by product.

tools.name: describe_hal
tools.description: Explains how the HAL autonomous sales agent works: the six-stage pipeline (find → research → qualify → quality control → draft → send) and key traits.

tools.name: get_customer_profile
tools.description: Returns the target customer profile for gethal.ai (industries, team sizes, regions, representative use cases) and any public reference customers.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company_info, get_pricing, get_products, get_playbook · Private data: get_company_info · Public sink: get_company_info, get_playbook, describe_hal.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_info, get_pricing, get_products, get_playbook · Private data: get_company_info · Public sink: get_company_info, get_playbook, describe_hal

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "get_pricing" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Returns the gethal.ai pricing plans (Solo, Team, Enterprise) with both monthly and yearly rates plus included features." → after: "Returns pricing for all four HAL products (Outreach, inbox-agent, Saga, vitr) plus the Outreach plans (Team, Enterprise) with monthly and yearly rates and included features."

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

remediation.title: Tool removed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "book_demo" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.
